summary: Resolve conversation ownership once and seek bounded identity and routing history

replay.detail: No claim replay or projection rules change; existing claims supply the same owner and route selections.

schema.detail: Adds partial accepted-time indexes for sparse conversation identity fields, actual-state source selection and runtime origins. Existing databases create the indexes on open without a schema version transition; no claims or existing indexes are removed.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; mixed-build members retain the existing replication contract.

compatibility.detail: No client-v0, peer protocol, pairing or harness contract change. Conversation routing and native reads reuse one pinned owner identity.

downtime.detail: First open of an existing database builds the new identity indexes before API availability. Index-build time on large installations has not been measured; subsequent opens reuse the indexes.

manual.detail: No operator steps or identity migration required.

recovery.detail: The added indexes do not alter stored claims and older binaries ignore them. Reinstalling an older binary leaves the extra indexes in place.
